_comment: D10: a Rust-DSL contract that is STATELESS once its parent class is resolved (#[runar::contract] with no mutable field other than tx_preimage, or #[runar::unsafe_contract]) and declares a tx_preimage field is refused by every tier's Rust-DSL parser with the shared diagnostic: the field is the implicit preimage of StatefulSmartContract, which a stateless contract never checks, so every extractor read of it is unverified. The tx_preimage field itself never makes a contract stateful. A stateful contract (#[runar::stateful_contract], or #[runar::contract] with another mutable field) keeps its tx_preimage field as the implicit, auto-checked txPreimage and must compile to the same bytes in every tier (accept cases; the examples/rust and state-array-set contracts are pinned byte-identical by the conformance suite).

refuse.name: contract-only-tx-preimage
refuse.error: a stateless contract cannot declare tx_preimage: nothing checks it against the spending transaction, so every field read from it is unverified; use #[runar::stateful_contract], or take the preimage as a method parameter and assert!(check_preimage(&preimage))
